pr_metadata_source.original_public_body:
Yolo permits Tend to merge ordinary code into the default branch, so a generic deployment credential available to that branch is already exposed to bot-merged code. Accept that exposure without requiring a reviewer for every deploy. Keep Tend's own operational credential checks, admin-gated tags, and reviewer gates for credentials restricted to bot-inaccessible refs.

The credential sweep still requires a reviewer for payload-driven triggers, including on the default branch: a fixed workflow can pass the bot's event payload to a credential-bearing step without running bot-merged code. Tests cover default-branch deploys, tag-only release credentials, and both trigger cases; the full generator suite passes.

> _This was written by Codex on behalf of max-sixty_
